channel.title: World Boxing News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from World Boxing News (worldboxingnews.com)

item.title: Isis Sio Family Clarifies 50-Day KO Timeline as Boxer Shows Recovery Signs
item.description: The family of Isis Sio clarifies the 50-day knockout timeline and provides a positive update on the boxer’s recovery while she remains in ICU.

item.title: Alexander Povetkin Record Remains Intact Despite Order to Disqualify Results
item.description: Alexander Povetkin’s professional record remains intact despite an anti-doping ruling that ordered results dating back to 2014 to be disqualified.

item.title: IBF Ruling Creates Champion Recruitment Problem for Zuffa Boxing
item.description: The IBF ruling that stripped Jai Opetaia of his cruiserweight title highlights a challenge for Zuffa Boxing as champions weigh the risks of losing belts.

item.title: IBF Title Loss Puts Jai Opetaia’s Zuffa Future in Doubt
item.description: Jai Opetaia faces uncertainty over his Zuffa future after the IBF vacated his cruiserweight title following the Brandon Glanton fight.

item.title: Boxing’s Next Step? A Super Bowl Halftime Fight
item.description: Could boxing stage a fight during Super Bowl halftime? World Boxing News examines whether the sport’s next step could reach the biggest stage.

item.title: Yoenis Tellez vs Brian Mendoza Scorecard from Las Vegas
item.description: World Boxing News provides a live scorecard for Yoenis Tellez vs Brian Mendoza from Las Vegas as WBN tracks the Fundora vs Thurman co-main.

item.title: Sebastian Fundora vs Keith Thurman Scorecard from Las Vegas
item.description: World Boxing News provides a live scorecard for Sebastian Fundora vs Keith Thurman. WBN scores every round of the WBC title fight.

item.title: Fundora Pounds, Dominates and Stops Thurman in Sixth Round
item.description: Sebastian Fundora overwhelms Keith Thurman with relentless pressure and power, stopping the former champion in the sixth round.

item.title: Battered Keith Thurman Does Himself No Favors With Fundora Stoppage Rant
item.description: Keith Thurman protests his TKO loss to Sebastian Fundora, but the visual and statistical reality shows the champion’s undeniable dominance.

item.title: Mayweather vs Pacquiao 2: Aged Pro Super-Fight in Doubt
item.description: Floyd Mayweather casts doubt on his professional rematch with Manny Pacquiao, leaving fans and promoters uncertain about its status and timing.

item.title: Sebastian Fundora Takes WBC Belt and Main Event Chain After Stopping Thurman
item.description: Sebastian Fundora stops Keith Thurman in Las Vegas to retain his WBC super welterweight title and claim the new WBC Main Event Chain.

item.title: Sebastian Fundora Rises in P4P Rankings After Clinic Against Keith Thurman
item.description: Sebastian Fundora rises in the pound-for-pound rankings after a dominant clinic against Keith Thurman in Las Vegas.

item.title: Nobody Wants to Fight Moses Itauma — the Heavyweight with Tyson-Like Power
item.description: Moses Itauma’s knockout of Jermaine Franklin has intensified comparisons to Mike Tyson as the rising heavyweight contender edges to a world title.

item.title: Manny Pacquiao Suffers Another Blow as Provodnikov Fight Falls Into Doubt
item.description: Manny Pacquiao’s comeback plans face uncertainty as the fight with Ruslan Provodnikov remains unconfirmed, according to the Russian’s manager.

item.title: Xander Zayas Risks Unified 154lb Titles Against Jaron ‘Boots’ Ennis
item.description: Xander Zayas risks his unified 154lb titles against Jaron “Boots” Ennis in a high-stakes summer clash at Barclays Center in Brooklyn.
